purpose: Exploratory retrospective association; not a forecast or causal test.
target: OAE annual production tonnes * 1000 / bearing rai; province-year.
interpretation_limits: The 2024-2025 results were viewed during this exploratory analysis; they are not an untouched confirmatory test.
The fixed three-month season is chosen from reported harvest tonnes in training years only; no validation/test-year monthly harvest values select the weather window.
The selected season is an approximate calendar window, not an observed flowering/fruit stage for each year.
Harvest data include cultivars; fruit-age scenarios are assumptions, not observed flowering dates.
Weather is one NASA POWER reference point per province, not a productive-area-weighted spatial mean.
Province fixed effects and a linear year trend do not control cultivar mix, irrigation, tree age, pests, or other management.
Do not interpret lower MAE or feature coefficients as proof of causation.
